## Evidence: CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock Invocations series vs the 5.5 alarm dimensions

Command (read-only): `aws --profile frontier --region us-east-1 cloudwatch list-metrics --namespace AWS/Bedrock --metric-name Invocations`
Run at 2026-11-10 18:06:26 PST.

Listed `ModelId` values (full output):
- (no dimensions — the account-level aggregate)
- amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0
- us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
- us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5
- us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0
- us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8
- us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0
- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6
- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5
- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5

Per-id match against the alarm dimensions on main (`infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf`, 6 dimension sites):
- `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5` — exact character match, series published.
- `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` — exact character match, series published.
- `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5` — exact character match, series published.

Result: all 3 of the 5.5 `ModelId` dimensions key onto published series; no bug to file for dimension spelling.

Adjacent finding (not this ticket's scope): the DEPLOYED alarms (`aws cloudwatch describe-alarms`, same time) still name the 4.x ids — `bedrock-cache-ratio-low-opus-4-8`, `bedrock-cache-ratio-low-sonnet-4-6`, `bedrock-unit-cost-high-opus-4-8`, `bedrock-unit-cost-high-sonnet-4-6`, and `rebar-bedrock-invoke-client-errors` (opus-4-8 / sonnet-4-6 / haiku-4-5). The ticket's approach assumed the operator had applied terraform; that apply has not happened. Separately, production MCP still resolves the 4.x models (bug reddish-drinkable-canvasback), so the 5.5 series above come from other callers (bot/local runs), not production plan review. Applying terraform is an operator step.
